summary: Linkage Global Inc, a Cayman-incorporated Nasdaq-listed (UZX) mail-order retailer, furnished a Form 6-K containing a notice and proxy statement for an extraordinary general meeting (the non-US equivalent of a special shareholder meeting) dated November 2, 2026, with the meeting set for November 19, 2026. Shareholders will vote on two proposals: adoption of amended and restated articles of association (special resolution) and a 36-for-1 share consolidation of Class A and Class B ordinary shares (ordinary resolution), raising par value from US$0.0575 to US$2.07 with fractional shares rounded up. No deal terms, advisor, or board recommendation beyond the proposals are stated.
